title: Fortnite Style Weakpoint mining
description: Weakpoints will appear flying when mining, hitting them will grant a mining buff.
body:
**Always tired of the same old mining?**
**Why not accept a small challenge with a reward!**

When mining, small weakpoints orbs will appear on any side of the block and hitting them will increase your mining speed temporarily!

they have a cooldown so they won't spawn all the time, but hitting them will grant you the haste potion effect!
